If an even number is followed by an odd number (not prime), the resultant will be the difference of the both the numbers multiplied by 2. III. If an even number is followed by a prime number, the resultant will be the sum of both the numbers. IV. If an odd number is followed by another odd number (not a perfect square), the resultant will be the difference of both the numbers added by the greater number. V. If an odd number is followed by another even number (not a perfect square), the resultant will be the sum of both the numbers. VI. If an odd number is followed by perfect square number, the resultant will be the sum of both the numbers divided by 2.
